sections.en: 9 ἔσεται ('will be') the codices have. 11 δύσγονον ('hard to produce') A : δυ ('dy') with the sign of a diameter B. 14-17 καὶ τὰ μητρικὰ ... διαπρέπουσιν ('and the maternal ... they are distinguished') omitted by A. 22 δημοσίοις ἢ βασιλικοῖς ('public or royal') A. 25 προκοπὴν ('advancement') A. 27-28 περιστάσει κοινῆ ('in common circumstance') A. 34 ἀποτυχίαι ('failures') A. 38 ἄπορροι ('destitute') A.

summary.headline: Interpretations of Planetary Squares
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of planetary squares, including Saturn with Mercury or the Moon and Jupiter with Mars, the Sun, Venus, or Mercury, describing effects on marriage, health, parents, children, status, occupations, wealth, and conduct according to planetary dominance.
